audience: developers who call Groq models and run batch jobs on a Groq account

useCases.title: Pick a model and run a chat completion
useCases.text: List the models the account can use, with their ids. Run one chat completion on a chosen model. The call is billed to the Groq account.

useCases.title: Check the status of a batch job
useCases.text: List the batch jobs of the organization with their status and request counts. Read one job to see its input and output files.

useCases.title: Summarize the failed requests of a finished batch
useCases.text: Read the metadata of a batch output file. Then read its text, which is cut at 200,000 characters, and sum up the failed requests.

useCases.title: Start a batch job from an uploaded file
useCases.text: Start a batch job from a JSONL input file that was uploaded with purpose batch. The job runs asynchronously and is billed to the account.

useCases.title: Cancel a batch job or delete an old file
useCases.text: Cancel a batch job that has not finished. Delete an uploaded file permanently, which can make a batch that still needs it fail.
